default_backend: configured WinRM target alias with dedicated constrained JEA endpoint
guards: unrestricted PowerShell remoting endpoints rejected when JEA is required
no arbitrary PowerShell, WMI, CIM, event-log name or backend host
typed schemas and strict unknown-field rejection
bounded pagination, response bytes, elapsed time, requests, items, fan-out, concurrency and rate
aggregate cluster state before relationship expansion
fixed FailoverClustering Operational event log with bounded lookback and optional 512-character message preview
observe_scope: cluster aggregate state counts and quorum summary
exact group detail with bounded resources
cluster shared volumes and capacity evidence

writes.future_rule: Any concrete write workflow must use a separate opt-in least-privilege identity and plan/approval/change/verify with exact approval binding, idempotency, pre-state and independent read-back verification.

deployment_data_policy: No organization-specific topology, credentials, IPs, cluster names or policies are stored in the public repository.
